Name: ✦ Metamorphosis
Description: <light_purple>It hasn't grown legs yet. When it does, everything changes.
- A modest early <red><bold>Life</bold> <reset>pool that erupts once it nears metamorphosis
- A gentle <red><bold>Heal</bold> <reset>and a <blue><bold>Sprint</bold> <reset>kick to reach the shallows
- <green><bold>Pickup</bold> <reset>reach for whatever drifts by the pond

Notifications.20: <light_purple>It's still just a tadpole — for now. Metamorphosis begins quietly.
Notifications.60: <light_purple>Legs sprout overnight — everything about it changes at once.
